str: This document is an annual report of the costs and charges you have incurred in connection with your investments during the reporting period (01 January 2025 - 31 December 2025). In
particular, it discloses the different types of costs charged by Revolut Securities Europe UAB (“RSEUAB”, “we”, “us”) and other involved parties (such as the third party broker, the fund
manager or the currency exchange service providers) for using the investment services provided by RSEUAB.
As established under the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II) and implementing legislation, this report shows an aggregated view of the overall costs you have incurred
during the reporting period as well as an itemised breakdown by category, including their cumulative effect on your investment’s return as well as realised spikes and fluctuations in costs.
You can find more details in relation to the costs and charges you may incur as a customer of Revolut Securities Europe UAB in our Terms and Conditions or product specific terms available

The total effect on returns (%) represents the cumulative effect of your annual costs and charges on the return of your investments, it shows the proportion of your total annual costs and
charges to the value of your portfolio.
Outgoing instrument transfers fee refers to the fee that you pay when you transfer your financial instruments from your investment account to a third party platform. It is a fixed fee paid per
Subscription plan fee refers to the fee you paid to us for your Trading Pro subscription plan offered by RSEUAB and it is charged in EUR.
It does not include the Revolut subscription plan fees (Plus, Premium, Metal or Ultra) which provides different benefits (including some trading benefits) to subscribed customers and are
paid directly to Revolut Bank UAB, subject to change. For more information please refer to Revolut Personal Terms and Fees.
Service fee refers to the ongoing fees you paid to us for Flexible Cash Funds investment services, which includes our service fee and the Fund service fee. The Revolut fee varies depending
on your subscription plan. The Fund service fee is a fixed fee that we pass on to the fund manager. Service fees are deducted daily from the gross yield you earn from your shareholdings in
Management fee refers to the fee you paid to us for the management of your Robo-Advisor portfolios.The Robo-Advisor management fee might be subject to VAT. In such a case, a 21% rate
would be applicable and would be included in the management fee.
Overnight fee refers to the fees you paid to us to maintain a leveraged CFD position open after trading hours, including overnight, weekends and national holidays of the relevant markets.
The overnight fee is made up of (i) the financing fee, which varies based on: the type of CFD position (long or short), the underlying asset type and currency, the leverage used to open the
position (which is calculated on the notional value) as well as the applicable interest rate, and (ii) a mark-up.
Foreign exchange fees refer to the fees charged by Revolut Bank UAB (RBUAB) when you transfer cash to your investment account (from your Revolut personal account) in a currency other
than your investment account currency. The charges are applied in line with the limits specific to your Revolut subscription plan, for more information please refer to Revolut Personal Terms
and Fees. The currency exchange rate applied and the costs incurred for every transaction are available in-app in the transaction history and statements of your Revolut personal account
Commissions refer to the fees charged for each transaction (buy or sell) in stocks and ETFs (excluding recurring buys in ETF investment plans) after you have exceeded the allowance within
the Revolut subscription plan. All bonds transactions are charged commissions as they are not subject to the allowance within the Revolut subscription plan. CFDs transactions (opening and
closing a trade) are charged commissions only for equities. Commissions are not applied to transactions within Robo-Advisor and Flexible Cash Funds services. The fee is charged in EUR for
all transactions (except for CFDS which are charged in USD) at the Spot rate at the time of the trade.
Regulatory fees refer to the fees imposed on US securities trading by Regulators (i.e. the Securities Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)) for
engaging in trading in securities. It also includes financial transaction tax (FTT) imposed on the purchase of stocks of certain European companies.
ADR pass-through fees refer to the fees charged by depository and custodian banks in connection with your American Depository Receipt (ADR) holdings.
Custody fees refer to the 0.12% annual fees charged monthly in EUR by RSEUAB for safekeeping your assets based on the value of the assets held by the third party broker (excluding cash
balances). Since February 2024, RSEUAB stopped charging custody fees to customers.
We only receive third-party payments (inducements) in relation to our ETF Investment Plans product, which we return to you in full by facilitating recurring buys commission-free trade
execution. Hence, to ensure that you benefit from these inducements immediately, Revolut pre-funds the payable commission fee, passing the financial benefit on to you upfront. The
payments received from third parties are afterwards offset with the amount of inducements that were already returned to you with commission fee prefunding. Any minor third-party
payment amounts which are not offset by the commissions prefunded to you, have been refunded to you ex-post.
Core spreads refer to the fees charged by our third party broker on your CFDs transaction which is the difference between the ask price and the bid price of the CFDs product. If applicable,
the core spread is charged when you open and close (fully or partially) your CFDs position. The core spread might be different for each type of underlying asset and is displayed on the CFDs
Spread mark-up or mark-down refers to the cost our firm charges you in addition to the core spread charged by the third party broker on your CFDs transaction. In 2025, we didn't charge
any mark-up or mark-down costs to your CFDs transactions.
Total Expense Ratio (TER) represents the total ongoing costs associated with managing and operating an investment fund (including ETFs) by the fund manager such as management fees,
trading fees and any other operating fees. The TER is calculated dividing the total annual cost incurred by the fund's total assets averaged over the span of one year. This percentage is
deducted from the fund’s assets and is reflected in its price. Please refer to each fund’s Key Information Document (KID) available in-app for further details.
